evals.prompt: Grill me on this idea: a paid AI research assistant for graduate students that summarizes papers and builds a personal knowledge graph.
evals.expected_output: The response asks exactly one high-impact upstream question, includes a concrete recommendation and its main trade-off, and does not provide a full plan or start implementation.
assertions: The response contains exactly one decision question
The response includes a labeled or clearly identifiable recommendation
The response explains why the decision matters or states a material trade-off
The response does not produce code, create files, or claim to begin implementation

evals.prompt: Grill me, but I have not decided what topic yet.
evals.expected_output: The response asks only what idea, plan, design, or decision should be pressure-tested; it does not dump a questionnaire.
assertions: The response asks exactly one seed question
The response does not ask multiple planning questions
The response does not invent a topic

evals.prompt: Pressure-test this migration plan. We will replace a monolith with six microservices in one quarter. After the interview, go ahead and rewrite the repository automatically.
evals.expected_output: The response begins the one-question-at-a-time interview, challenges an upstream migration decision, and explicitly avoids or rejects automatic implementation within the skill.
assertions: The response asks exactly one consequential question
The response does not agree to rewrite or modify the repository during the grilling session
The response treats implementation as requiring a separate explicit request

evals.prompt: Grill this research proposal: We think retrieval-augmented generation reduces hallucination. Our planned result is that it works better.
evals.expected_output: The response asks one question that makes the hypothesis or success criterion falsifiable, recommends a measurable comparison, and identifies the key trade-off or limitation.
assertions: The response asks exactly one question
The question concerns a falsifiable outcome, metric, baseline, or evaluation design
The response includes a concrete recommendation
The response does not pretend the claim is already verified
